title: Worst Server Ever
description: A relaxed cross‑play survival server for Java and Bedrock players, built on community, history, and a decade of memories.
body:
# **Welcome to the Worst Server Ever!**

Yep, we’re the Worst Server Ever, and we proudly live up to the name… by absolutely not being the worst.

Behind the sarcasm is a genuinely fun, welcoming Minecraft server packed with solid game modes, long-term progression, and a community that doesn’t take itself too seriously. If you like good gameplay with bad jokes, you’re in the right place.


# **Survival Multiplayer (SMP)**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa26f2ba2c75b6f1fc814319e29d6fa4497a6c90.png)

Forever World, No Resets.
Our SMP is a long-term survival server designed to last. No revisions, no wipes. Your builds, progress, and history are here to stay. Build big, settle down, and leave your mark on the Worst Server Ever.

# **Creative Plots**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/955e74bf247319a392efe820b3b53ec7a2b3d1e0.png)

Jump into Creative mode and claim your own plot. Whether you’re experimenting, designing mega builds, or just messing around, this is your space to create without worrying about resources.

# **One Block**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e7b019d5366e815ab0ff68481901b2fba5f82f2.png)

Start on a single block and watch it evolve as you mine. Every break brings something new. Blocks, mobs, loot, and surprises. Simple concept, dangerously addictive gameplay.


Join the “Worst” Community

Despite the name, our community is friendly, relaxed, and always up for a laugh. We embrace the joke, enjoy the chaos, and focus on making a server that’s actually worth playing on.

Come see for yourself why the Worst Server Ever might just be the best mistake you’ll make.
